title: Creating Account Nicknames
content:
Account Nickname
To create an account 'nickname', navigate to the platform's Trading page and click the pencil icon to the left of the account within the account drop-down.
Upon creating and saving the account 'nickname', the new nickname will automatically appear across the platform within the account drop-downs, Accounts tab, Trade Copier, and the Performance Stats page.
